title: A river of resources (d3-sankey)
description: D3 Sankey computes node positions and flow widths for an original three-stage resource network. Changing the branch share preserves the total flow.
description_ko: D3 Sankey가 직접 만든 3단계 흐름망의 노드 위치와 선 두께를 계산해요. 갈림길 비율을 바꿔도 전체 흐름의 양은 유지돼요.
prompt: A river of resources. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
summary: A river of resources. Change the controls to explore the actual algorithm.

try_ko: Node gap으로 노드 사이를 벌려 보세요
